title: Stalled tasks to the top of the Dashboard, and a budget on every task

message.text: Plan: one Sonnet minion extends the asks tick that already marks stalled asks so it also judges every task of the last 7 days (no log line for 2 h, not landed, no live agent → stalled) and writes one derived file, /framework/ai/tasks.json, that the Dashboard reads. Snooze, Kill and Re-prioritise are verb lines on the task's own log, behind three Servex tools, so the buttons and agents call the same code. Each task carries its Budget: line and its spend.json total side by side; a missing budget shows as missing. The Dashboard builder (panel2-sessions) gets the file shape in one message. Brief: /framework/ai/2026-10-02/stalled-and-budgets/requirements.md ($13).
